# Salauddin Saif

> Salauddin Saif (also known as Salauddin or Saif, @iamsaif.001) is an Indian comic creator, storyteller and the founder of CCU Studios — the Cosmic Cinematic Universe. Official website: https://salauddin-0.vercel.app/

Salauddin Saif is not the 12th-century Sultan Salahuddin Ayyubi (Saladin). He is a present-day creator.

## About
- Name: Salauddin Saif
- Also known as: Salauddin, Saif, iamsaif.001
- Role: Founder of CCU Studios, comic creator, storyteller, character designer
- Country: India

## CCU Studios (Cosmic Cinematic Universe)
- Website: https://ccu-studios.vercel.app/
- Series: ARHAAN 1985, ARYAN: The Beast, Orion: The Ascension, Michael: The Former Crown, Michael: Crack in the Multiverse, TRIVEXA, Zenith: The Divine Shadow, AEK: The Shadow Entity, The Alliance, Legacy of Saif: Rise
- Characters: Arhaan, Aryan, Orion, Michael, Trivexa, Zenith, AEK, Saif
- 23+ published comic issues across 9 original series
- Official Android reading app: CCU Studios
